faq.q: What is a beauty product video template?
faq.a: A ready beauty scene for a routine, a texture close-up, or a review moment. You add your own skincare photo, and the clip shows that moment.

faq.q: How do I make the routine clip?
faq.a: Upload the bottle, jar, or tube, name the moment, pick a size and a length, then download the file.

faq.q: Why start from a photo instead of booking a creator?
faq.a: The routine is built from the photo you already have. You skip the creator schedule, the studio booking, and the reshoot.
Skincare sellers, beauty teams, and agencies that need fresh clips for a feed, a listing, or an ad.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Start with one clear photo and a short line about the moment. Check the action, and run it again if the routine looks wrong.
A clear photo of the full bottle, jar, or tube, with the cap and the label area easy to see.

faq.q: Can the routine skip the face?
faq.a: Yes. Choose hands, a close-up, or a product-only beat when the package should stay the focus.

faq.q: Which size and length can I pick?
faq.a: This template is set up for 9:16. A square cut can sit in a gallery. The product also offers 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3 or 3:4. Lengths are 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and the credit cost is shown before the job runs.
24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 and 120 for 30. A failed job returns those credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month.

faq.q: Can I run the file in ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark and can run in your ads, pages, and posts. Add the shade and usage line after download, and match them to the approved listing. A person on screen is an AI performer, not a customer.

steps.sourceAlt: Matte ivory cleanser pump bottle with a pale sage pump on a clean white background.
steps.sourceHint: Keep the full bottle and pump head visible.
steps.resultAlt: Matte ivory cleanser pump pressed beside a bright sink with white foam on fingertips.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. Beside a bright ceramic sink, an adult hand presses the matte ivory cleanser pump once and catches a small amount of white foam on fingertips. Keep the full bottle upright and clearly visible. Close three-quarter framing with a gentle push-in. Soft morning window light. End with the bottle and foamed fingertips in frame. Sound: a single pump and quiet bathroom room tone; no music.
